context: Sho tells Grandma about collecting stickers.
purpose: Casual home register; vocabulary (久々/そのうち/コレクション/損/どころ) in natural home.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: おばあちゃん、久々にシール集めてるよ!
lines.en: Grandma, I'm collecting stickers again after a while!
lines.style: excited small child voice, bright warm bouncing delivery throughout

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: まあ、コレクションが増えたのね。
lines.style: tender grandmother voice, soft warm gentle delivery throughout

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: うん、コレクションがいっぱいなんだ!
lines.style: proud small child voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 交換して、損しなかった?
lines.en: When you traded, didn't you lose out?
lines.style: gentle grandmother voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 損どころか、レアなのもらえたよ!
lines.en: Far from a loss, I got a rare one!
lines.style: delighted small child voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: そのうち、立派なコレクションになるわね。
lines.en: Eventually it'll be a fine collection.
lines.style: tender grandmother voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: そのうち、全部集めるんだ!
lines.style: eager small child voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 久々に、楽しそうで何よりね。
lines.en: It's wonderful to see you having fun again.
lines.style: tender grandmother voice, soft warm affectionate closing delivery throughout
